versions.changelog:
Initial release of browser automation skill for CLI.

- Automates web browser interactions using natural language commands via CLI.
- Automatically selects between local Chrome and remote Browserbase environments based on configuration (no user prompting).
- Provides commands for navigation, interacting with pages, data extraction, element discovery, screenshots, and browser closure.
- Supports both quick start usage and detailed troubleshooting guidance.
- Includes a table outlining feature differences between local and remote modes.
- Best practices and setup instructions clearly documented.
